task.description: Run the EE-09 test suite and produce a test report. Commands: (1) zig build test — runs all unit tests including engine_ee09_tests step; (2) zig build — verifies build is clean. Report results to tests/reports/EE-09-test-report.md covering: test count, pass/fail per TC, any failures with error messages. All unit tests (TC-EE-09-U01 through TC-EE-09-U10) must pass. Integration tests (TC-EE-09-01, 02, 04, 05 stubs) must compile cleanly. If any tests fail, set result.status to FAIL and populate result.issues with severity and description for each failure.
acceptance_criteria: All unit tests for EE-09 pass

result.summary: All 10 EE-09 unit tests pass (TC-EE-09-U01 through TC-EE-09-U10). Integration test stubs compile cleanly after fixing 8 categories of compilation bugs in ee09_merge_variables_test.zig and adding cel import to bpm_src_mod in build.zig. 4 EE-09 integration tests skip at runtime (no BPM_TEST_DB_URL) — requirement remains PENDING until DB run. No pre-existing test regressions.
